why: motet#45, reconstructed: the staging false positive where a claim about 185 flagged ballots was refused because 185 sat a paragraph outside the sentence it quoted. The citation is the tightest verbatim span the script stage could locate, which is what makes it a good citation; the number is still the source's own word.

claims.spoken: The board certified the count on Thursday after reviewing 185 flagged provisional ballots.
claims.cited: The board voted to certify the count on Thursday evening
